hooks.name: Run unit tests on source save
hooks.description: Runs the Vitest suite whenever a TypeScript or script file is saved under template/ (src, test, scripts, starter) or an app's src/ or test/ folder, so a broken geofence, smoothing, hunt-link, result-link or app-generator rule is caught at once. A PostFileSave command hook cannot block the save; a failing suite is reported back to the agent.
